scope.purpose: Inventory existing inputs for one two-endpoint network-by-species concentration analysis.
scope.prior_results_role: Existing source inventories, frozen specifications and previously viewed result receipts are provenance and exposure disclosures. They are not newly recomputed common effects.
scope.recovery_policy: Recover only the already-used original input or saved artifact, verify its recorded identity, and retain missing-input status until recovery succeeds. Do not substitute a shorter series, a higher-level aggregate, a new source, or a prior effect estimate.
scope.branch_policy: Integrate on one working branch. JNCC is a pinned read-only source reference from an existing other branch, not an instruction to merge its old analysis gates.

verified_file_record_basis: Sixteen current-file paths, byte lengths and SHA-256 values supplied in the already-verified /tmp/unify_source_hashes.json inventory; no new hashes or ecological calculations were generated for this catalog.

sources.dataset: JNCC comparative seabird counts: Seabird 2000 and Seabirds Count
sources.count_unit: Preserve the original source unit; do not combine units within a row.

coverage.interpretation: Seventeen original species labels are an inventory total. Actual synchronous network-by-species rows must be established from the original survey-year fields.
coverage.taxon_label_policy: Keep original labels, including Razorbil; record any standard display name separately instead of silently changing the source key.

pinned_existing_repository_reference.reference_status: Existing code, specifications and aggregate results are available at the pinned Git reference.
pinned_existing_repository_reference.rules_reused_for_this_draft: V39 within-network agreement of the original early survey year and of the original late survey year only.
rules_not_inherited: Old effect estimates or null p values as common two-endpoint outcomes

sources.recovery_status: Pinned metadata and aggregate results available; original workbook not found in Git or Library inventory.
limitations: Do not infer a synchronous time point from a census label or the median of asynchronous child-site survey years.
Do not assume adjusted values are integer counts; preserve the recorded estimate type and apply the common count null only where the draft specification permits it.
Original Start.Lat/Long are source start points, not verified colony centroids.
sources.prior_view_status: Existing JNCC outcome summaries and old concentration analyses have been viewed; new common effects have not been computed.

source_geographic_coverage.basis: Existing source inventory supplied for this catalog; this is geographic coverage metadata, not a newly re-read list of literal Country cell labels.
source_geographic_coverage.literal_country_field_policy: Preserve original Country values in network keys when the original workbook is recovered; do not replace them with these display labels.

Atlantic Puffin.policy: Use only the publisher comparable sheet for Atlantic Puffin; do not combine it with alternative Puffin source sheets.

parent_child_duplicate_policy.rule: Within the original species x Country x Master-site x count-unit parent, exclude a child Site record when its literal normalized Site name equals the normalized Master-site name and that parent contains other child Site.ID values; an aggregate-over-child record cannot be ruled out.
parent_child_duplicate_policy.limitation: This conservative metadata rule can discard valid sites and does not resolve all source boundary changes.

sources.dataset: Pinned APBP/MAPPPD nest-count snapshot, unambiguous site-species-season derivation
sources.network_definition: Original MAPPPD region; the geographical network identity does not include species.
sources.component_type: original site_id; may be a colony, sector, island site or mainland site
sources.derivation: Numeric nest observations were grouped by site_id, species_id and breeding-season start year; groups with conflicting count values were excluded rather than averaged, while identical-count duplicate source records can remain flagged by n_rows.
sources.raw_snapshot_local_status: The original work/data_audit/mapppdr CSV/RDA paths recorded in source_manifest.json are absent from this checkout; their identities and the derived table are retained.
sources.recovery_status: Existing derived point-count table available for Step 1; original metadata recovery is separate and must preserve the frozen source identity.
sources.endpoint_selection_status: Pending endpoint_registry. Apply STEP1_TABLE_SPEC.md using observation presence, IDs and methods, without looking at concentration, growth direction or climate.
sources.zero_and_missing_policy: Retain explicit recorded zero counts. A missing site-species-season record is unobserved, not zero. Do not inherit a both-endpoints-positive selection from an older analysis.
limitations: The 32 region-by-species strata include sparse strata; no final eligible sample size is claimed.
Original site_id is not an independently verified physical island.
Same mathematical concentration metric does not remove differences among census methods or accuracy categories.
sources.prior_view_status: Counts, regional support and earlier demographic/climate results have been viewed. The new unified endpoint roster and excess-concentration outcomes have not been computed.
sources.row_definition: Network x species x count unit x fixed matched site cohort x endpoint pair.
sources.cohort_definition: Species-specific fixed matched original site_id roster; stored separately from network_id.

sources.dataset: LaRue et al. 2024 author-provided emperor colony posterior summaries
sources.network_definition: Original ice_reg, eight fixed sector labels
sources.coordinate_status: Static source colony anchors, not annual movement observations.
sources.recovery_status: Original author CSV is available unchanged; joint posterior samples are not available in the existing catalogued inputs.
sources.uncertainty_policy: Do not round N_mean into individual counts and do not simulate independent colony marginals as a joint posterior. D2 calculated from N_mean is a point allocation index, not posterior mean D2.
sources.zero_and_missing_policy: Modelled zero adult index is distinct from an unobserved value and from confirmed permanent colony extinction.
sources.prior_view_status: The 2009-to-2018 global and eight-sector allocation results were already reported and viewed; no new common effects or trait/climate tests were computed here.

sources.dataset: Palmer LTER within-island Adelie breeding-pair census
sources.network_definition: Each physical island with a fixed monitored colony-code roster
sources.current_cache_role: The available five-island 1991-2017 totals and existing concentration result receipt establish provenance and prior findings. Island totals cannot reconstruct concentration among within-island colony codes.
sources.recovery_status: Original within-colony-code source is missing locally; recover the existing source or saved artifact, not a new data lineage.
sources.zero_and_missing_policy: Keep the recorded final Litchfield zero and the resulting total-loss status; do not switch to its last positive year to obtain a finite concentration response.
sources.coordinate_status: An island representative point cannot stand in for coordinates of its monitored colony codes.

lineage_overlap.policy: Reconcile original site-species-season lineage; do not count reused field counts as independent regional and local observations.

sources.prior_view_status: Existing within-island concentration results and Litchfield zero history are known. Old full-time-series slopes or p values are not the new two-endpoint response.

sources.dataset: Canonical Signy Adelie and chinstrap breeding-patch counts
sources.network_definition: Signy Island; the geographical network identity does not include species.
sources.component_type: canonical monitored breeding patch within species
sources.count_unit: Preserve the exact breeding-count unit in the original frozen source contracts.
sources.current_cache_role: The existing matched-count cache covers 2012-2019 and does not supply the canonical 1996 starting endpoint. It must not silently replace the 1996-2019 series.
sources.recovery_status: Canonical long-period originals are missing locally; the short matched cache and frozen contracts are available.
sources.alternative_history_not_an_additional_re: The other 1998-2009 eight-literal-unit Adelie version is a different representation of the same study system, not an additional independent network.
sources.q4_status: Source A and C patch labels are different geographical units; do not take their union and zero-fill the absent species to manufacture spatial separation.
sources.prior_view_status: Original Signy concentration findings and alternative coding schemes are known. The new common two-endpoint effects have not been recomputed.
sources.cohort_definition: Each species retains its original fixed canonical monitored patch roster; species-specific cohort_id is separate from network_id.

sources.dataset: Ross Island six MAPPPD aerial census sectors
sources.component_type: six original aerial census sector codes

planned_coverage_from_existing_contract.district_aggregation_role: Resolution comparison, not another independent network.

sources.recovery_status: Underlying sector counts and the existing source/crosswalk specification are available.
sources.duplication_status: Confirmed reuse of the same MAPPPD sector count records; never add to the parent regional row as independent primary replication.
limitations: Six sectors are not six independent islands or climatic regions.
Aerial census values are not automatically a universally standardized error-free breeding-pair count.
sources.prior_view_status: Existing six-sector and three-district allocation results are known; the new two-endpoint common null has not been computed.

climate_existing_input_status.role: Step 2 covariate definition and Step 5 physical exposure; no climate association is fitted at the catalog stage.
climate_existing_input_status.uk_historical_sst: Saved UK SST values for the planned networks and periods have not been located in the existing inventory.
climate_existing_input_status.antarctic_historical_temperature: Existing historical GLORYS thetao is potential temperature; it must not be relabelled as a common UK-Antarctic SST covariate.
climate_existing_input_status.future_temperature: Existing CMIP6 tos materials are available, but existing model/location coverage is not evidence that every new network and species is covered.
climate_existing_input_status.historical_sea_ice: Existing Antarctic sea-ice analyses provide candidate inputs; network, period, spatial weights and variable identity still have to be frozen under Step 2.
climate_existing_input_status.policy: Use only existing source identities and saved inputs; retain NA and the reason when the common variable or geographic coverage is absent. Do not substitute air temperature or differently defined ocean temperature for SST.

cross_source_rules: All final eligibility counts remain unset until endpoint_registry is created and checked.
Keep explicit observed/modelled zeros separate from missing or unobserved records.
Do not reuse declining-only selection, a favourable endpoint, or prior significance as a row-selection rule.
Macro-primary, local-resolution and model-index rows share a catalog and descriptive scale but do not automatically share sampling errors or independent replication.
No global emperor joint uncertainty is inferred from independent marginal summaries.
Q4 requires both species on the same surveyed spatial components and the same endpoints; absent records are not zero-filled.
Current hashes identify files that are actually present; recorded expected hashes identify unavailable originals and do not imply recovered bytes.

Future exposure weights use the late recorded distribution within included matched monitoring networks, not an assumed complete species-wide census; report census vintage and distinguish climate-input coverage from species population coverage.
